name: Desifounder

sources.title: Homepage — founder community: 2,600+ founders, 2,400+ launches; free signup; Spotlight Launchpad for weekly launches
Spotlight page — live weekly launch board + FAQ: free forever, manual screening, entries go live Mondays, one launch per product (30-day cooldown for major updates)

requirements: Must register a free Desifounder account to apply
Any founder/maker can apply — solo, team, student, indie hacker
Manual screening for quality/relevance/spam before inclusion
Same product can only launch once; reapply after a 30-day cooldown only for a significant update/redesign
preparation: Product name, one-line description, URL, and category (categories include SaaS, AI/ML, Productivity, E-commerce, Marketing, Development Tools, Finance, etc.)
Timing: submit during the week; approved entries launch publicly every Monday
workflow: Submit the product to Spotlight any day of the week
Manual review; if approved, it appears in the next Monday Spotlight lineup
Earn community upvotes; featured placements can include community newsletters/posts
watchFor: Launches batch to Monday — submission timing does not change go-live day
One-shot per product; don't waste it on a premature listing (30-day cooldown for relaunch)
Community skews Desi/Indian founder ecosystem though open to all
'Premium features free during beta' — pricing may be introduced later
Low vote counts visible on current entries — modest audience, mainly a feedback/discovery play
countsAsLive: The product appears in the public Spotlight lineup at desifounder.com/spotlight after a Monday launch batch
unknowns: Approval rate and how far in advance of Monday to submit
Whether upvotes confer any lasting ranking after the launch week
